summary: Cellectis S.A. filed a Form 6-K on May 11, 2026, furnishing a press release reporting its financial results for the first quarter of 2026 and providing a business update. The filing details clinical trial progress for its gene-edited cell therapies, cash position of $188 million, and expected milestones. There is no mention of any strategic transaction, acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or management change. This is a routine earnings and operational update, not a special situation.
